prayers.title: Grounding & Stillness
prayers.text:
Source of life, meet me in this ordinary room.
Let my attention come back from every direction.
My feet are here. My breath is here. This moment is enough to begin.
Hold what feels scattered without forcing it to become calm.
Let me return to the next small thing with steadiness.
Amen.

prayers.title: Connection To Source
prayers.text:
Creator and Source, nearer than my searching,
I turn toward You without needing perfect words.
Where I feel distance, let there be room for honest longing.
Where I feel silence, let it become a place of listening rather than proof of absence.
Gather the scattered parts of me into the fullness from which they came.
Let trust rise gently, without pretending all questions are answered.
I rest before You now.
Amen.

prayers.title: Enough Light
prayers.text:
Source of wisdom, I do not ask to control the future.
I ask for enough light for the next faithful step.
Quiet the pressure to know everything at once.
Let my values speak more clearly than my fear.
Help me choose what is honest, kind and possible today.
Amen.

prayers.title: Refuge And Boundaries
prayers.text:
Source of refuge, bring me back to what is real and near.
Let my body remember the ground beneath me.
Let my attention return to this room, this breath, this moment.
Give me calm boundaries: what is mine to carry, what is mine to set down, and where I may seek help.
May I move with steadiness and ordinary wisdom.
Amen.

prayers.title: Lament Without A Clean Ending
prayers.text:
Source of mercy, I come without a clean ending.
This loss is heavy, and I will not pretend it is light.
Receive the ache, the anger, the silence, the memories that arrive without asking.
If comfort comes, let it come gently.
If it does not come today, stay with me in the dark.
Let love remain love, even here.
Hold me as I carry only the next breath.
Amen.

prayers.title: Set This Day Down
prayers.text:
Creator of the night, I set this day down.
What I finished, I release.
What remains unfinished, I leave for another hour.
Let my body soften without being commanded.
Let my thoughts pass like distant sound.
Keep me in quiet until morning, and return me gently to the world.
Amen.

affirmations.text: Right now, I can return to one breath or one sound.
I do not have to feel peaceful to begin.
Grief is allowed to take the space it needs.
What matters most is still available in this next small choice.
This is hard, and struggling is not proof that I am failing.
I set this down for tonight.
I can do what is mine and release what is not.
When I feel scattered, I will pause for three breaths or one sound.

practices.name: Three-Minute Grounding
steps: Look around and name, silently, three things you can see.
Choose an anchor: breath, sound, touch or an object in the room.
Rest attention there for five slow cycles.
When the mind leaves, return without scolding yourself.
Close with: I am here, and this is enough for now.

practices.name: Five-Minute Breath Prayer
steps: Choose a phrase with two halves, such as Source of life / hold me gently.
Let the first half meet the inhale and the second half meet the exhale.
Keep the breath natural; do not force it to slow.
If breath focus is uncomfortable, use the phrase with ambient sound instead.
Close by noticing the room and one next action.

practices.name: Ten-Minute Lament Practice
steps: Ground with sound, touch or breath for one minute.
Name the grief or complaint plainly.
Let there be silence without fixing it.
Ask for what is needed today, not for the whole future to resolve.
Choose whether to add a trust line; do not force it.
Close by feeling the ground and naming one form of support available now.
